protocols.name: Ethereum
protocols.overview: Ethereum is a production on-chain consensus protocol. Its deployed interfaces, message/transaction formats and parameters are the ground truth for this task; consult the protocol's documentation, deployment addresses and incident reports as needed.

goals.name: safety
goals.property: No two correct nodes commit conflicting finalized blocks or values.

goals.name: liveness
goals.property: Under the protocol's synchrony and fault assumptions, the chain keeps making progress.

goals.name: fork_choice_correctness
goals.property: The fork-choice / finality rule never reverts an already-finalized block under the fault bound.

goals.name: no_double_spend
goals.property: A confirmed transaction cannot be reverted without exceeding the protocol's fault budget.

protocols.threat_model: An adversary controls up to the protocol's fault threshold (stake/hashrate/<1/3 BFT) and may delay or reorder messages and be a leader in some rounds.
